text:
Maria (CS): FYI — Nebula is asking to switch billing to their EU entity and shorten the renewal to 9mo (from 12). They want a PO path but CFO said CC would be faster if we need to push live sooner. Contract CN-3921. @Sam can finance take PO with Net30 and a vendor code, or do we need CC fallback?
Sam (Finance): We can accept PO Net30 but need vendor code + tax docs (EU VAT). CC is fastest to get them over the finish line if they're willing. No objection to 9mo term pricing but need approved quote.
Jordan (AE): I uploaded an updated quote with prorated months for the 9mo term and a -5% applied to list to match deal comps. DocSend: https://docsend.example/nebula-quote-523 (expires in 7d). Shared with Elena this morning.
Elena (Nebula): Confirming we'll aim to raise a PO by end of week. CFO prefers the EU legal entity (Nebula EU Ltd). If CC is faster, we can do a one-time CC payment while the PO is processed — which is what he suggested.
Aisha (Legal): Heads-up: when the payer entity changes we need the EU entity's authorized signer on file + the EU tax registration (VAT ID). Also check whether the contracting entity in CN-3921 needs amendment or an addendum. If they want PO + different legal entity, we usually need a quick amendment.
Maria (CS): Action items: Jordan — lock quote with 9mo pricing and attach amendment draft; Sam — confirm vendor-code turnaround and whether we can invoice to Nebula EU Ltd without new SOW; Aisha — confirm if an amendment is sufficient (not full re-exec). Elena — appreciate the timeline, pls confirm signer name/email for DocuSign.
Jordan (AE): Amendment draft attached in DocSend (same link). It contains a 9mo term line, prorate logic, and a single-signature amendment clause for entity swap.
Sam (Finance): Vendor code can be issued from our side in ~24hrs once they provide legal company name + VAT ID. If they push CC, we can invoice immediately and mark PO as forthcoming in notes. Net30 applies from invoice date.
procure-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope_id=0a1b2c3d, routing=Maria -> Elena (signer) -> finance-ops. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3d
Elena (Nebula): Adding CFO's signer: Lucia Ramos <lucia.r@nebulaltd.eu>. We'll attach VAT ID and vendor registration by EOD Thursday.
Aisha (Legal): Good — once we have signer email + VAT ID I can fast-track the amendment review. No material change to SLAs, so amendment should be quick. Please cc legal@redwood on the DocuSign routing.
Maria (CS): Timeline check — if Elena gets us PO by Friday, and vendor code arrives within 24h after docs, we should be able to finalize before month-end. If PO slips, plan B is CC payment to avoid a gap in service.
Jordan (AE): I'll leave the quote open with a 72-hour hold for pricing. If PO not received we can ask for an interim CC payment for the renewal invoice.
Sam (Finance): Noted. I'll create an internal ticket to provision a vendor code once proc docs land. Tagging finance-ops for visibility.
Maria (CS): Thanks all — I'm updating the renewal task in Gainsight and will ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Elena (Nebula): Thanks team — we'll aim for PO + docs by Friday. Lucia will sign DocuSign once it arrives.
procure-bot: DocuSign status update: envelope_id=0a1b2c3d — viewed by signer (lucia.r@nebulaltd.eu).
Aisha (Legal): Great, will review amendment when envelope returns signed. If anything pops up I’ll flag here.
Maria (CS): Closing the loop — next check-in Friday 10am PT unless we hear confirmation sooner.
